title: Cancer Screening Camp
summary: A Free Cancer Screening Camp was organised on 15th November 2026, from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM, at Balwadi, Near Hanuman Mandir, Mahul Gaon – 400074.
description:
A Free Cancer Screening Camp was organised on 15th November 2026, from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM, at Balwadi, Near Hanuman Mandir, Mahul Gaon – 400074.

The camp was organised jointly by Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF), Cancer Patients Aid Association (CPAA), Chandra Sundara Trust (CST), and Rotary Community Corps (RCC), Mahul.

The initiative aimed to promote cancer awareness, encourage early detection and improve access to preventive healthcare services for the residents of Mahul.

Impact:
- Promoted awareness about cancer prevention and early detection.
- Encouraged residents to undergo cancer screening and prioritise preventive healthcare.
- Improved awareness about the importance of timely medical consultation.
- Strengthened community participation in healthcare initiatives.
- Fostered collaboration between Rotary, healthcare organisations and local institutions.
location: Balwadi, Near Hanuman Mandir, Mahul Gaon – 400074., Mumbai, Maharashtra
